title: Even Us Up: Interac e-Transfer Settlement Gateway — MVP Phase 1
objective: Build MVP for Interac e-Transfer settlement integration in Even Us Up. Users register Interac Direct email, request settlement, generate reference #, manually confirm via their bank app, and view settlement history.

included: KYC verification schema (email-only verification for MVP)
Manual confirmation flow (user enters transaction reference)
Frontend components: KYC form, settlement modal, history view
E2E testing: settlement flow with mock data
User documentation: Interac Direct setup guide

deliverables.name: Database Schema (Migrations)
deliverables.description: settlement_methods, settlement_requests, user_kyc, compliance_events tables with RLS policies
acceptance_criteria: All tables created with correct field types + constraints
RLS policies restrict user access to own data only
Indexes on household_id, member_id, status for query performance
Encryption schema for PII (full_name, phone, address, email, dob)

deliverables.name: Backend API Routes
deliverables.description: Supabase functions or Express routes for KYC, settlement creation, confirmation, history
acceptance_criteria: All endpoints return correct status codes (200, 400, 401, 422)
Error messages clear + helpful (no generic 500s)
Rate limiting on KYC (max 5 attempts/hour)
Transaction IDs/references generated correctly
No PII in logs or error responses

deliverables.name: Frontend Components
deliverables.description: React components for KYC, settlement modal, history, status indicators
acceptance_criteria: Components match Figma designs (if available) or use consistent styling
Form validation prevents invalid submissions
Email verification flow works end-to-end
Mobile responsive (tested on 375px width)
Loading states + error messages visible to user
No hardcoded data (all from API)

deliverables.name: State Management
deliverables.description: Zustand store extensions for settlement flow (kyc, requests, methods)
acceptance_criteria: Store actions: submitKYC, registerSettlementMethod, createSettlement, confirmSettlement
Loading/error states properly managed
Persist settlement history locally (optional, for offline support)
No race conditions (concurrent API calls handled)

deliverables.name: Testing Suite
deliverables.description: Jest + React Testing Library + E2E tests (Cypress)
test_coverage: E2E: Full settlement flow (register → request → confirm)
acceptance_criteria: Unit test coverage >80% for critical paths
E2E test passes: user registers → creates settlement → confirms
Mock VoPay API for testing (no real API calls)
All tests pass in CI (GitHub Actions or similar)

deliverables.name: Documentation
deliverables.description: User guide, API docs, setup runbook for Joe
files: docs/INTERAC_SETUP_GUIDE.md (user-facing: how to enable Interac Direct)
DEPLOYMENT.md (how to deploy Phase 1 to production)
acceptance_criteria: User guide is <5 min read, includes screenshots
API reference has curl examples for each endpoint
Deployment guide includes rollback procedure
No typos or broken links

deliverables.name: Security Review Checklist
deliverables.description: Confirm no PII leaks, encryption working, RLS enforced
checklist: [ ] All PII fields (email, phone, DOB, address) encrypted at rest
[ ] No PII in API error messages or logs
[ ] RLS policies tested (user cannot query other users' KYC)
[ ] Rate limiting on sensitive endpoints (KYC, settlement creation)

functional: Users can complete KYC email verification in <2 minutes
Settlement request creation works (test with 5+ scenarios)
Settlement history shows past 50 requests without performance issues
All error cases handled gracefully (network down, invalid input, etc.)
No crashes or 500 errors in production logs
quality: Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA (focus states, labels, keyboard nav)
Performance: Settlement history loads in <1s (50 items)
compliance: KYC data encrypted (Supabase encryption or libsodium)

validation_commands.lint: npm run lint && npm run type-check

blockers_and_dependencies.mitigation: Phase 1 uses mock API; Phase 2 integration separate
Can launch MVP with basic email verification (low risk); formal review in Phase 3

required_before_phase_2: Phase 1 MVP fully deployed to production
Manual settlement confirmation tested with 50+ users
VoPay sandbox credentials obtained by Joe
VoPay MSA draft reviewed by legal
phase_2_prerequisites.phase_2_scope: Auto-send settlements via VoPay API; webhook-based status updates

notes.architecture: Settlement flow is intentionally simple for MVP: register → request → manual confirm. VoPay API integration comes Phase 2. This reduces complexity + launches faster.
notes.compliance_note: KYC email-only verification is intentionally minimal for MVP. Phase 2 will add full KYC (DOB, address, etc.). Personal use exemption from FINTRAC likely applies for household groups.
notes.monetization: Premium tier (Phase 3) will be separate feature flag. MVP is free to establish user base + gather feedback.
notes.fallback_strategy: If VoPay integration stalls in Phase 2, manual confirmation remains viable. Settlement still happens; just requires extra step.

approval_status: Ready for HAL dispatch upon Joe approval
